verdict.rationale: There is no first-party import or migration tool (e.g. CSV or competitor importer) in the evidence. Moving data in relies on third-party sync apps listed in the directory: one-way or two-way sync from Jira, monday.com, Wrike and similar tools; Skyvia and Hightouch data integration; or building your own importer on the REST API that creates tasks. missing for 10: native import/migration feature, CSV import, documented switching/migration guide, hands-on evidence of a successful migration.
